title: RuntimeObservation
description: Closed wrapper-owned metadata for one StepId/request_id. Semantic boundary: canonical UTF-8 JSON <=16384 bytes; request_id must match its step, provider_reported_model must match RuntimeResult.model, known byte counters must reconcile. No prompt/text/tool arguments, local paths, secret references, argv or credentials. Observation never proves process start/kill, ownership or acceptance. See runtimes.md §4.7.1.

executable_sha256.description: Digest of the executable actually bound to this launch under §4.3, otherwise null; never re-detect from a mutable locator after the run. Wrapper/interpreter binding remains governed by the verification context.

verification_key.description: Existing SHA256 canonical VerificationContext key used for this launch, if known; a copied key is metadata, not new positive security evidence.

provider_reported_model.description: Provider claim parsed from the runtime stream/result (RuntimeResult.model), not independent verification and not the requested/resolved model.

clock_domain_id.description: Opaque capture-process epoch, renewed after process restart. Neither StepId nor a cross-host monotonic clock. null when no single process epoch covers the observation.

duration_ms.description: Local monotonic capture-start to final-drain duration within one process epoch; null if unavailable or the summary crosses epochs. Never subtract UTC/provider timestamps.

provider_first_at.description: Optional provider-claimed time of the first observed record, when actually exposed; never substituted for observer UTC.

coverage.description: Completeness of the local stdout/stderr capture/parser scope; separate from native tool visibility and live delivery.

bytes_seen.description: Raw stdout+stderr ingress bytes actually observed, counted once. Does not estimate bytes never drained/generated.

bytes_retained.description: Ingress bytes admitted to the primary bounded capture before redaction; disk copies/sidecars still share the existing disk reservation.

bytes_dropped.description: Observed ingress bytes not retained; when all three counters are known, seen=retained+dropped. Live event drops are counted separately.

gaps.description: Bounded flags, not raw payloads. provider_sequence_gap requires an actual exposed native sequence and proved missing native records; SessionEvent.seq is adapter-owned and cannot establish it. Live-only gaps do not imply incomplete local capture.

live_events_dropped.description: Number of bounded live-enqueue failures observed by the wrapper; null when unavailable/no sink. Zero means measured absence of enqueue loss, not proof of remote delivery.

coverage.description: Provider-native tool visibility for the captured scope, separate from local capture completeness. Native tools not exposed by the CLI remain unavailable/partial.

observed_calls.description: Known tool call observations, possibly partial; null for unavailable visibility. An incomplete scope cannot justify an aggregate total of zero.
